semiconductor_relevance: High — Riken Keiki Taiwan provides critical gas monitoring and factory control systems essential for semiconductor manufacturing safety and compliance.
summary: Riken Keiki Taiwan Co., Ltd. specializes in providing gas monitoring equipment and factory monitoring and control systems (FMCS) for the semiconductor industry. Their products, including explosion-proof gas detectors, are crucial for maintaining safety standards and regulatory compliance in semiconductor manufacturing environments.
capabilities: SD-2500 and SD-2600 pressure-resistant gas detectors

regional_presence.Taiwan: Strong presence with locations in Tainan, Taichung, Taipei, and a new office in Hsinchu, supporting the semiconductor industry's demand for gas monitoring solutions.
